name: DoughnutChart
description: DoughnutChart – Presentational Chart.js doughnut chart with custom HTML legend matching the MDK design

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit suffix appended to values in tooltips and legends

props.name: legendPosition
props.description: Where to place the legend relative to the chart (default: 'top')

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Custom HTML tooltip configuration. When provided, replaces the default doughnut tooltip (which shows label, value with…
props.descriptionFull: Custom HTML tooltip configuration. When provided, replaces the default doughnut tooltip (which shows label, value with unit, and percentage). Use `valueFormatter` to replicate the percentage display if needed

props.name: minSliceAngle
props.description: Smallest angle, in degrees, a visible non-zero slice is drawn with, so a tiny share (e.g. 0.5%) stays visible. Only the…
props.descriptionFull: Smallest angle, in degrees, a visible non-zero slice is drawn with, so a tiny share (e.g. 0.5%) stays visible. Only the drawing changes: the legend and tooltip keep the true values and percentages. `0` draws every slice to scale

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats slice values in the built-in legend and default tooltip (default: raw number)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class for the root element

fields.name: color
fields.description: Slice color (falls back to the built-in palette)
